== Research Notes ==

A possible identification concerns James Glasgow. The 11 June 1674 Irvine inquest for Robert Hunter of Hunterstoun’s service as heir includes James Glasgow in Didup.<ref>Shaw, Some Family Papers of the Hunters of Hunterston, printed p.62 entry89; [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CSM7-J962-6 record].</ref> Printed retour extract inspected; underlying original uninspected. FamilySearch’s Linlithgow1546–1564 title is a catalogue mismatch. The extract gives James no age, trade, relatives or vital date. The identification remains uncertain.
